import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
rows=[l for l in open('protein.shape.q1.pdb') if l.startswith('ATOM')]
ca=[l for l in rows if l[12:16].strip()=='CA']
x=np.array([[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])] for l in ca])
print('atoms',len(rows),'CA',len(x),'chains',Counter(l[21] for l in ca))
x-=x.mean(0)
u,s,v=np.linalg.svd(x,full_matrices=False)
print('singular',s,'bounds',np.ptp(x,axis=0))
p=x@v.T
np.save('coords.npy',p)
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,6))
for ax,(i,j) in zip(axs,[(0,1),(0,2),(1,2)]):
 ax.scatter(p[:,i],p[:,j],s=3,c=np.arange(len(p)),cmap='turbo')
 ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.set_title(f'PC{i+1}, PC{j+1}')
fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig('projections.png',dpi=140)
PY

import os
os.environ['MPLCONFIGDIR']=os.path.abspath('.mplconfig')
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
p=np.load('coords.npy')
fig,axs=plt.subplots(4,6,figsize=(18,12))
for row,tilt in enumerate([0,30,55,75]):
 for col,az in enumerate(range(0,180,30)):
  a,b=np.deg2rad([az,tilt]); up=np.array([0,np.cos(a),np.sin(a)]); right=np.array([np.cos(b),-np.sin(b)*np.sin(a),np.sin(b)*np.cos(a)])
  q=np.column_stack([p@right,p@up]);ax=axs[row,col]
  ax.scatter(q[:,0],q[:,1],s=2,color='black');ax.set_aspect('equal');ax.set_title(f'az {az}, tilt {tilt}');ax.axis('off')
fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig('rotations.png',dpi=130)
PY
python3 views.py"
